name: Okoru to Shinimasu.
source:
The protagonist Nanami Nao is quite the contrarian. His childhood friend Aoi Miki, always upset at his meddling, has been inflicted with a mysterious disease!?
To save her, "love" is necessary...?

As the two of them become (temporary) lovers, in the end can the protagonist manage to save the heroine, his childhood friend!?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27769]Freem![/url]]
